sources.locator: "Spanish colonization of the Americas", revision 1376245871, lead

explanation: This edge claims only what the article's first sentence states: the Spanish colonization of the Americas **"began in 1493 on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola after the initial 1492 voyage of Genoese mariner Christopher Columbus under license from Queen Isabella I of Castile"**. The voyage is what the settlement of 1493 followed from and was licensed under; the article says nothing about how much of what came after was decided by it, and neither does this link.
